verses.text: Yujto na'an winhaj Noé chi' yuj Dios yet' masanil nok' nok' ayoch yet' winh t'a yol te' barco chi', yuj chi' ix ak'jikot jun ik' te ow yuj Dios t'a yib'anh ha ha' chi', yik wach' stupem ha'.
Ix makchaj masanil sjaj ha ha', ha' sk'eul t'a yol lu'um yet' jantak ha' niwak ha' skot sekekok t'a satcha'anh. Ix och wa'an yak'an nhab'.
Oye' ujal ix kan ha', ix och ijan stupxiem ha', k'ojank'olal ix tupem ha'.
17 k'uhalxo yoch yukil uj, ix kan b'akhnaj te niwan barco chi' t'a sjolom jun lum witz t'a yol yik Ararat.
Numumi yem ha ha' chi'. Ha t'a b'ab'el k'uhal yik lajunhexo ujal, chekelxo sjolom lum niwak witz.
Haxo yik ix ek' 40 k'uhalxo, ix sjakan te' wentena winhaj Noé b'ob'il yuj t'a te' barco chi'.
Ix yaktanelta jun nok' joj winh, ix ek' jenhenhok nok' stanhwan stupem ha' t'a sat lu'um.
Ix yaktanpaxelta jun nok' uch winh yik syil nok' tato takinhxo sat lu'um.

Haxo nok' uch chi', ix k'ochxi nok' t'a te' barco chi', yujto malaj b'aj syal skan wa'an nok'. Te sib'anto ek' ha' t'a sat lu'um chi'. Ix yak'anelta sk'ab' winh yik scha'anxioch nok' winh t'a yol te' barco chi'.
Ixto stanhwej ukexo k'uhal winhaj Noé chi', ix yak'anelta nok' uch chi' winh junelxo.
Numumixo sk'ik'b'i ix k'ochxi nok', nhak'b'ilxo jun te' xil olivo yaxxo yuj nok'. Icha chi' ix aj yojtakanel winh to wan stakji sat lu'um.
Uketo k'u ix stanhwej winh, ichato chi' ix sjakanelta nok' winh junelxo, palta majxo k'ochxoklaj nok'.
601 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Noé chi', ayik ix takjixi lum lum chi'. Ayik b'ab'el k'u yoch b'ab'el uj ix yik'anel yib'anh te' barco chi' winh, haxo ix yilan winh to takinhxo lu'um.
Haxo t'a 27-xo k'uhal yoch yik schab'il ujal, te takinhxo lu'um.
Haxo ix yalan Dios t'a winh:
Elanhkot t'a yol te' barco yet' ix etb'eyum yet' heb' uninal yet' heb' ix alib'.

Tzik'anelta masanil makanhil nok' nok' ayoch het'ok: Nok' much, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultakil nok', nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um. Unewokab' nok' yik sb'ut'jixi sat lu'um tik yuj nok', xchi Dios.
Ixlajwi chi', ix elta winhaj Noé chi' yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' yuninal yet' heb' ix yalib' t'a yol te' barco chi'.
Ix elixta nok' nok' chi' smasanil t'a junjun makan.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'o'an jun altar winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix yik'ankot nok' molb'etzal nok' winh yet' nok' much, haton nok' smoj yoch silab'il t'a Dios. T'a junjun makan nok' chi' ix yik'kanel junjun nok' winh snhustz'a silab'ok t'a yichanh Jehová.

Te wach' sjab' nok' silab' chi' ix yab' Jehová. Yuj chi' ix yalan icha tik: Manhxo ol in katab'ej lum lum tik yuj smul heb' anima, yujto yiktax unin anima heb', anhej chukal snib'ej heb' sk'ulej. Manhxa b'ak'inh ol in satel masanil tas pitzan, icha ix wutej t'a junel tik.

Yakb'an ayto ek' yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol awchaj sat awal inhat, ol molchajpax sat. Ay stiempoal k'ak', ay stiempoal si'ik. Ay stiempoal nhab'il k 'inal, ay stiempoal waresma. Ay k'uhalil, ay pax t'ak'walil, xchi Jehová.
